description:
Offline chess against Maia-3 with local Stockfish analysis

Mobile Maia is an offline-first chess app built around Maia-3, a human-like chess model developed by the University of Toronto Computational Social Science Lab.

Play against Maia at a selected rating without creating an account or connecting to a server. The Maia-3 model and Stockfish are bundled with the app, so games and analysis remain on your device.

Features include:

  • Play as White, Black, or a random side
  • Maia ratings from 800 to 2200, plus a custom rating
  • Unlimited play, clock presets, and custom time controls
  • Human-like move timing and adjustable Temperature and Top-P
  • Single or multiple premoves, with an optional 100 ms penalty
  • Takebacks, endgame draw offers, rematches, and automatic game restoration
  • Experimental Chessnut Go play with LEDs, sounds, battery status, reconnect recovery, and phone continuation
  • An analysis board with FEN and PGN import and export
  • A graphical position editor and persistent analysis variations
  • Offline Stockfish evaluation and Maia move comparison
  • Fast, Balanced, or Thorough full-game analysis
  • Full-game accuracy scores and a navigable evaluation graph
  • Brilliant, Good, Interesting, Dubious, Mistake, and Blunder move classifications
  • Two Stockfish suggestions and visible Maia/Stockfish agreement
  • Lichess-style material difference beside each player
  • Offline opening names and ECO codes from the Lichess opening database
  • Historical clocks and timed PGN export with standard clock annotations
  • PGN export with variations and game metadata

Mobile Maia is independently developed free software. Its source code is available under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 only.
